description: Start, update, or end a live progress card on the room members' lock screen (an iOS Live Activity / Android live update). Reuse the same correlation_id for every ping of one stream: the first ping starts the card and sends one alert, further "running" pings move it silently, and the first "done"/"failed" sends one completion alert and ends it. Free accounts get a small number of NEW streams per day; updates and the final ping of an open stream are never charged; a first ping that is already "done"/"failed" counts as a new stream.

action.description: Quick-action slot to attribute the stream to (supplies the icon and sound).

correlation_id.description: The stream key. Reuse it on every ping of the same stream.

data.description: Arbitrary structured context (max 25 keys / 8KB), returned on read surfaces after connector privacy filtering. Do not put secrets in data.

live_status.description: The live card's state. Only state is required.

accent_override.description: Hex #rrggbb; a semantic accent for one frame (e.g. deadline red).

category.description: Legacy rendering category; prefer template. "alert" has NO template equivalent and is the only way to start a stream time-sensitive (breaks through Focus). Fixed at stream creation.

center.description: Center score/clock for the matchup template.

current_segment.description: Progress template only: how many segments are filled, 0..segments (422 invalid_current_segment otherwise). When progress is omitted the server derives progress as current_segment / segments.

current_step.description: Index into steps; the only mutable steps field.

deadline_at.description: Epoch seconds the countdown template counts down to. A later ping may move it; duration_seconds then moves by the same amount. Send the absolute new deadline, never a delta.

delta.description: Value template only: the change, e.g. "+3.2%".

duration_seconds.description: Countdown duration in seconds. Read from the first ping only (a later ping's own value is ignored); preserved through updates and completion. Moving deadline_at on a later ping changes the stored duration by the same amount.

eta_at.description: Epoch seconds; renders a live ETA on status/progress.

left.description: Left side {label,value} for the matchup template.

metrics.description: Up to 3 {label,value} counters for the metrics template.

options.description: Up to 4 {value,label} choices for the question template.

prompt.description: The ask, for the question template.

right.description: Right side {label,value} for the matchup template.

segments.description: Progress template only: draw the bar in this many equal segments. Cannot change once set (a different value on a running ping is rejected with 422 segments_immutable).

started_at.description: Timer template only: epoch seconds the timer counts up from. Defaults to now on the first ping and cannot change afterwards (422 started_at_immutable on a running ping). The card ticks by itself; send a message update at least every 15 minutes or the stream is ended as stale. A done/failed ping freezes the card at the final elapsed time.

state.description: running keeps the card live; done/failed end it with one completion alert.

stats.description: 4 to 8 {label,value} pairs for the stats template, drawn as two rows. Required on the first ping of a stats stream (422 stats_required). Labels and values may change on later pings; omit the field to keep the stored list. When message is omitted the server writes "Label Value · Label Value" so an older app reads it.

steps.description: Step labels. Required on the first ping of a steps stream. They cannot change afterwards: a later ping may resend the identical list or omit it, and a different list on a running ping is rejected with 422 steps_immutable (a done/failed ping ignores it and still ends the stream). Send current_step to advance, or start a new stream with a new correlation_id for a different list.

template.description: Which layout the OS renders. Fixed at stream creation. "timer" counts up from started_at, "value" shows one prominent value and "stats" shows 4 to 8 labelled values; an app that predates them shows the plain status card (title and message). "claim" is a "Who's on it?" request one member takes on (private rooms only): its text is title (or message), up to 120 characters, an optional deadline_at is at most 8 hours away, and it then moves only through live_claim, or a done/failed ping from you that finishes or cancels it.

trend.description: Value template only: the arrow drawn beside delta. Neutral colour: up is not always good.

value.description: Value template only: the one prominent value, e.g. "$12.4k". Required on the first ping of a value stream (422 value_required).

value_label.description: Value template only: what the value is, e.g. "Revenue".

requires_ack.description: Add an Acknowledge button; the first eligible member to tap resolves it for everyone. Does not raise the interruption level — set category "alert" for a time-sensitive start.

tags.description: Up to 10 labels to file this ping under, so history can later be filtered by one (list_notifications and wait_for_notification take a tag). Each is 1 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter or digit. Trimmed, lowercased and de-duplicated for you. Set by the ping that starts the stream; later pings of the same stream may repeat or omit them and never change them.

title.description: Card title. Every template takes at most 40 characters and refuses a longer one; only the claim template takes up to 120 (its request text), which is why this schema allows 120. Defaults to the selected quick action's label.

name: live_status

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.
